recipes.name: Cheesy Tomato Pasta
recipes.description: A quick and easy weeknight meal
ingredients: 1 pound dried pasta (penne, rotini, or your favorite)
directions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook pasta according to package directions.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, bring to a simmer, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain pasta and add it to the sauce. Toss to combine.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese and basil (if using). Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs with Toast
directions: Whisk together eggs and milk in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat. Pour in egg mixture.
As the eggs begin to cook, gently push cooked portions from the edge towards the center with a spatula, allowing the uncooked liquid to fill the empty space.
Continue cooking until eggs are scrambled to desired doneness.
Meanwhile, toast bread to your liking.
Serve scrambled eggs on toast and enjoy!

recipes.name: Black Bean Burgers
recipes.description: A delicious and vegetarian alternative to traditional burgers
ingredients: 1 (15-ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, mash black beans with a fork until slightlychunky.
Stir in cooked brown rice, rolled oats, red onion, bell pepper, garlic, olive oil, cilantro, chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Mix well until combined and the mixture holds its shape.
Form the mixture into 4 equal patties.
Place patties on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes per side, or until golden brown and heated through.
Serve burgers on hamburger buns with your favorite toppings.

recipes.name: Spicy Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.description: A quick and flavorful dish with a kick
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breasts, thinly sliced
directions: In a bowl, toss chicken with soy sauce and cornstarch. Set aside to marinate for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Add chicken and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until browned and cooked through.
Remove chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add bell peppers, broccoli, and onion to the pan. Cook for 3-4 minutes, or until softened slightly.
Stir in garlic and cook for another 30 seconds.
In a small bowl, whisk together chicken broth, sriracha, brown sugar, and sesame oil. Pour the sauce into the pan with the vegetables.
Add the cooked chicken back to the pan and toss to coat with the sauce.
Serve over cooked rice (optional) and enjoy!

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
recipes.description: A healthy and delicious layered breakfast
directions: In a glass or jar, layer half of the Greek yogurt.
Top with half of the granola and half of the berries.
Repeat layers with remaining yogurt, granola, and berries.
Drizzle with honey (optional) and serve immediately.

recipes.name: One-Pot Lemon Garlic Chicken and Rice
recipes.description: A simple and flavorful one-pot meal
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
directions: Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Season chicken with oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken to the pot and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until browned on all sides.
Stir in rice, diced tomatoes with their juices, chicken broth, and half of the parsley.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until rice is cooked and fluffy.
Stir in remaining parsley and lemon slices. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
recipes.description: A classic and easy lunch option
ingredients: 1 can (5 oz) tuna in water, drained
directions: In a bowl, mix together tuna, mayonnaise, celery, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Spread the tuna salad mixture onto one slice of bread.
Top with lettuce (optional) and the other slice of bread.
Cut the sandwich in half and enjoy!

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
ingredients: 1 grilled or baked chicken breast, sliced
directions: In a large bowl, combine romaine lettuce, chicken, croutons, and Parmesan cheese.
Drizzle with Caesar salad dressing to taste and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Veggie Wraps
recipes.description: A customizable and light lunch option
directions: Spread hummus evenly onto one tortilla.
Layer mixed greens, cucumber, bell pepper, and carrots on top of the hummus.
Sprinkle with feta cheese (optional).
Drizzle with a little olive oil (optional) for extra flavor.
Roll up the tortilla tightly and enjoy!

recipes.name: Leftover Soup and Salad
recipes.description: A quick and easy way to use up leftovers
directions: Reheat leftover soup according to package instructions.
In a bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, and feta cheese (optional).
Drizzle with vinaigrette dressing (optional) to taste.
Serve the salad alongside the reheated soup.
